input: Schedule a parent-teacher conference for next week

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which teacher(s) and child this is for determines who needs to be contacted and coordinated with.
Whether the meeting is in-person at school or virtual changes the logistics entirely — room booking vs. video link.
The parent's available days and times next week narrow down when the conference can actually be scheduled.
Understanding the purpose — routine check-in, academic concern, behavioral issue — shapes how to frame the request to the teacher.
Knowing the preferred contact method for reaching the teacher (email, school portal, phone call) determines the immediate next action.
Knowing the desired meeting length helps ensure enough time is blocked and the invitation reflects realistic expectations.
Whether the parent wants to prepare an agenda or talking points beforehand affects what additional tasks need to be planned.

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a parent-teacher conference next week
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a parent-teacher conference to take place sometime next week.

questions.title: Which teacher and child is this conference for?
questions.description: Identify the specific teacher(s) and the child involved so the right people can be contacted.

questions.title: Will the meeting be in-person or virtual?
questions.description: Determine the format of the conference to handle the correct logistics — school room or video call link.

questions.title: Which days and times are you free next week?
questions.description: Capture the parent's availability to narrow down viable time slots for the conference.

questions.title: What is the main reason for this conference?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a routine check-in, an academic concern, or a behavioral matter to frame the meeting request appropriately.

questions.title: How do you normally contact this teacher to schedule?
questions.description: Identify the preferred channel — school portal, email, or phone — to determine the immediate next action.

questions.title: How long should the conference ideally be?
questions.description: Establish the expected duration so the calendar invitation and the teacher's availability request reflect realistic time needs.

questions.title: Do you want to prepare talking points beforehand?
questions.description: Determine whether drafting an agenda or list of discussion topics should be included as part of this plan.
